# CONN-0288 OpenAI Moderations fixtures

Every `openai-moderations-*.synthetic.json` file is a handwritten, deterministic synthetic model of the public first-party OpenAI Moderations contract retrieved on 2026-07-20. No fixture was captured from a provider, generated by an SDK, or obtained through an API request. No credential, account, or paid/live provider interaction was used.

The fixtures deliberately use synthetic IDs, content, scores, errors, and a non-credential test token. They exist only to exercise request normalization, fixed-category response reconstruction, error handling, timeout behavior, and redaction. Source contract: <https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/moderation> and <https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/moderations/create>.
